text.p: These are leading stories in this morning's Paris newspapers.
Due to a journalists' strike on Tuesday, Les Echos, La Tribune Desfosses, Le Figaro were not published today.
-- Bill to fight illegal labour to be presented to cabinet meeting this morning.
-- Unions to ally for Thursday's strike, which brings together civil servants, teachers, public transport and utilities workers, doctors and others.
-- Real-estate analysts says prices have fallen by nine percent over a year in the Paris area.
-- Europe's markets boom in unison in the wake of Wall Street record highs.
